picks.editorial_note: Purdue leading two of the first 278 DOE Genesis Mission awards signals major federal investment in AI-accelerated science, including work on the Electron-Ion Collider — a strong early marker of how this national initiative will reshape scientific computing.
picks.title: 2 Purdue AI research projects selected among the first Genesis Mission awards

picks.editorial_note: SRI, Mayo Clinic, and the University of Florida are combining smart glasses and AI guidance under an ARPA-H-funded initiative to help healthcare workers perform procedures like blood draws and intubation — a tangible step toward AI-augmented frontline medical care.
picks.title: AI guides healthcare workers through blood draws, intubation, and more - SRI

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's £20 million MRC-funded hub pairs stem-cell-derived tissue models with AI to speed drug development, representing a substantial, well-funded bet on AI-driven biomedicine.
picks.title: Cambridge to lead new £20m MRC Hub to transform development of new medicines using stem cells and AI

picks.editorial_note: Northeastern's DOE- and SLAC-backed agentic AI 'scientist' that can autonomously design and run experiments is a genuine step toward self-driving labs, with real potential to accelerate the pace of scientific discovery.
picks.title: This AI scientist can run experiments. Self-driving labs coming next

picks.editorial_note: HappyRobot's billion-dollar valuation as TUM's 23rd unicorn is a striking commercial validation of AI agents for business process automation and a major win for European AI entrepreneurship.
picks.title: HappyRobot is TUM's 23rd unicorn

picks.editorial_note: HKU's RoboDojo, built with nearly 20 global universities including UC Berkeley and Tsinghua, establishes the first unified benchmark for embodied AI robot reliability — exactly the kind of cross-institutional standard-setting that shapes an entire research field.
picks.title: HKU Pioneers "RoboDojo": The First Hong Kong-Led Unified Benchmark for Embodied AI, Setting New Global Standards for Robot Reliability - Press Releases - Media - HKU

picks.editorial_note: University of Alabama's DOE Genesis Mission award with Fermilab applies AI to sift massive volumes of high-energy physics data, pairing federal funding with a national-lab partnership to tackle a genuine big-data bottleneck in fundamental physics.
picks.title: AI meets particle physics in UA-Led Department of Energy project

picks.editorial_note: UCLA's use of generative AI to design entirely novel proteins, building on Nobel laureate David Baker's foundational techniques, pushes computational protein engineering into new territory with real implications for medicine and biotechnology.
picks.title: UCLA bioengineer Jason Zhang deploys AI to create proteins never before seen in nature

picks.editorial_note: The new AI for African Population Health Unit at the University of Cape Town, backed by South Africa's Medical Research Council, is a notable investment in building AI/ML tools tailored to underrepresented health data and populations.
picks.title: New unit a shot in the arm for healthcare research in Africa

picks.editorial_note: EPFL's VirTues foundation model for spatial proteomics offers a new way to analyze tumor tissue organization across cancer types, with direct potential to improve treatment response prediction.
picks.title: AI model maps tumor tissue to improve cancer care
